card.name: The word capacity meaning ability
card.fires_on: The noun "capacity" meaning ability, usually after "the", "adaptive" or "patient's" and before "to" or "for". It also fires on a few related word starts like "incapac" and "gou".

modes.label: Capacity as ability
modes.description: The word capacity used for the ability to do or change something.

modes.label: Odd word starts
modes.description: Partway through rarer words such as gouging or incapacitate.
